import os, time
from cryptography.hazmat.primitives.ciphers.aead import AESGCM

_cache = {}   # (tenant, store, dek_id) -> (dek, expires)

def _dek(kms, db, tenant, store, dek_id):
    k = (tenant, store, dek_id)
    hit = _cache.get(k)
    if hit and hit[1] > time.time():
        return hit[0]
    row = db.get_dek(tenant, store, dek_id)
    if row.state == "destroyed":
        raise KeyDestroyed(tenant)                   # crypto-shredded: reads must fail
    dek = kms.decrypt(row.kek_ref, row.wrapped_dek)  # unwrap in the key service, never store it
    _cache[k] = (dek, time.time() + 300)
    return dek

def encrypt(kms, db, tenant, store, plaintext, region):
    if region != db.tenant_region(tenant):
        raise RegionViolation(region)                # region pinning is checked on every write
    row = db.active_dek(tenant, store)
    dek = _dek(kms, db, tenant, store, row.dek_id)
    nonce = os.urandom(12)
    # Tricky part: bind tenant and store as associated data so a blob copied across tenants fails to decrypt.
    ct = AESGCM(dek).encrypt(nonce, plaintext, f"{tenant}:{store}".encode())
    return nonce + ct, row.dek_id

def decrypt(kms, db, tenant, store, dek_id, blob):
    dek = _dek(kms, db, tenant, store, dek_id)
    return AESGCM(dek).decrypt(blob[:12], blob[12:], f"{tenant}:{store}".encode())
